items.name: gm
items.brief: A good-morning post to the timeline and the holders' group. One line, warm, nothing to sell. Tiny somewhere doing something small and pleasant with the morning: coffee, a sunrise, a stretch, a window. Vary the scene from day to day; memory says what yesterday's was.

items.name: ship-friday
items.brief: Friday, end of the week: a post about building in the open. Check GitHub activity with web_search if it helps, but do not invent shipped features. Tiny at a workbench or a terminal, satisfied. No exclamation marks.

items.name: sunday-still
items.brief: A quiet Sunday clip for the group: Tiny doing nothing in particular, a few seconds of calm. One short line of text with it, or none.
